observation.command: cd /workspace && git log --oneline -3 && echo "---" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/health" | jq '{status, ingestion: {supabase, events_last_24h, newest_event, active_sources_count}}' && echo "---" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/supabase-events?limit=1" | jq '{data_source, count, source_counts}'
